verdict.rationale: The product's own GitHub README says users can add MCP servers from the Library in Settings, and that every model sees the same skills and tools. That covers both plugging in MCP servers and the agent using their tools. Missing for 10: whether arbitrary or custom MCP servers can be added beyond the Library, configuration and transport details (stdio/HTTP), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Add skills and MCP servers from the Library in Settings. Every model sees the same skills and tools.
